summary: Second consecutive fully silent week — zero messages from either side. Hannah (Bella) churned on 2026-07-06 and is now 46 days silent. The last message in the entire chat is Stephski's 8/4 nudge, so the chat has been dead for 17 straight days and nobody at ALTR made a single collection, escalation, or win-back attempt during this window. The final 7/1-7/7 invoice is still unissued — it is now 37 days past the cadence date it should have gone out on (ALTR invoices on the 1st and 15th) — and the exit balance she promised is still uncollected. Critically, the outstanding amount has never been written down anywhere: the only record of it is a photo she sent on 7/6 captioned "This is total left" that nobody transcribed. ALTR is carrying an unquantified receivable against an unresponsive ex-client, on a dead channel, with no named owner. This needs a decision this week, not another silent week.

Log the churn root causes into the retention playbook and close this account out of the weekly client rotation: weak week-1 sub numbers, a billing dispute over commission on self-run lives, three bank/payment-rail changes in five weeks (Zelle -> Mercury -> Chase -> Bank of America), and leaks she kept reporting as still live.
